text.text: A creation of the Foundation and a veteran of countless battles. This Chiliarch roamed the Ætherside until he recovered his lost sword and tore open a moment for his return.

A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Captain. Only veterans who have demonstrated gifts for command, exceptional combat prowess, and achieved true valor in war will receive the chance of becoming a YSTF Captain.

A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Glaiver. Such Yinglungs are extremely skilled in leading assaults and taking defended positions. The glaives they wield are designed to cleave through Aggeloi with ease.
A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Elite. An Yinglung who has mastered both the Originium Arts and swordmancy will be considered an elite.
A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Vanguard. Mastering melee combat techniques is just the most basic requirement for the Yinglungs.

A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of Blitzcrash. The beast was once raised at Tanjian Hall and used to be Li Zhiyan's best friend. Its blightshade, however, retains nothing but its instincts for aggression.
A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a rakerbeast. The eye-spotted coat seems more fluid and highlights attack moves that are truly terrifying to behold.

A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a quillbeast. This blightshade seems to exhibit far more aggressive rolling and bouncing attacks than its living counterpart, though it may just be a matter of imagination.

A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a tuskbeast. Although this is but a "lingering shadow", its sharp fangs are still capable of tearing through armor and protective gear.

Craghowlers are the dominant members of rockhowler communities. These beasts will fight each other countless times before the strongest champion emerges as the leading craghowler. There is no question that such individuals have mastered combat in ways that their kin could only dream of.

A variant of manglerbeasts that evolved specifically on Talos-II. These unique manglers are armored in extremely thick scales and share a mutualistic symbiosis with rockhowlers. The former species provides the bulwark and muscle while the latter offers keen senses and warns against trespassers.

Craghowlers are the dominant members of rockhowler communities. These beasts will fight each other countless times before the strongest champion emerges as the leading craghowler. There is no question that such individuals have mastered combat in ways that their kin could only dream of.

A howlerbeast that grew up in the wilderness. This beast is indigenous to Talos-II. Strong membranes on its head and neck allow it to unleash powerful howling loud enough to shake the hills and forests.
The Conqueror's inner perception of herself. She does not hide her desire to lay waste to Civilization.
Thanks to Nefarith, the "Bonekrushers" became a byword for terror in the Civilization Band. Her brutal conquest has not yet ended, and her true ambitions have not yet been revealed.
A phantom that answered Ardashir's call. It is a manifestation of destruction, a sedimentation of ancient senescence.
Ruan Yi had kept his anger in check for years. When a fleeting "opportunity" presented itself, he decided it was time to finally unleash his pent-up fury.
A criminal equipped with heavy weaponry. Obliteration is no small feat. Only the strongest smashers armed with quadruple rocket launchers can achieve the title of Cloud Obliterator.
A criminal armed with a heavy weapon. The name may sound like an exaggerated joke, but the Hill Smasher's quadruple rocket launcher delivers serious firepower. Do not underestimate this foe.
A criminal armed with an exotic weapon. Such Cloud Stalkers are so skilled in hooked blades people claim they could slice and dice the very clouds into perfect cubes.
A criminal armed with a strange weapon. When the Cloud Stalker is tired of using the strange lantern, he would draw his short blade and engage in melee combat.
A criminal armed with a strange weapon that appears like a harmless lantern. Do not be fooled. The Cloud Stalker's "lantern" is actually a flying decapitator with terrifying reach.
A criminal armed with basic ranged weaponry. Keen sight and dexterous hands allow for deadly shots. This Wind would blow through buildings to sweep all the valuables away.
An armed criminal active in Wuling territories. They would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Some of them would even attack travelers.

NO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Its physical manifestation would appear like extensions reaching out from its main body. However, these appendages actually reach into the main body and have been postulated to serve as a form of distraction.

NO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been categorized as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Its outward appearance mimics that of Nefarith. Despite its high core energy readings, the entity seems to be rather unstable.
A wild creature infected by Originium with extremely high body temperatures. Its dorsal carapace is imbued with Originium dust with higher levels of activity.

A wild creature infected by Originium with extremely high body temperatures. This slug explodes when near death, covering everything nearby with acidic body fluids at boiling temperatures as well as active Originium dust.

The "Anavatklydan" (archive ID: AGM32L) is a non-model variant of AGM321. Such entities come in a wide range of sizes. The sight of particularly large individuals breaking out of the water has become a nightmare for those who witnessed it.
The right fist of Nefarith and the most feared Bonekrusher soldier of the clan. Many Landbreakers had challenged Nefarith's leadership, only to be utterly crushed by Rhodagn's fists.

A Landbreaker combatant equipped with heavy explosive gauntlets. These serve as the mainstay of Bonekrusher mobs. A Siegeknuckles's gauntlets serve as portable weapons for taking down fortified positions.

A Bonekrusher combatant armed with spears and shields. Though armed with weapons crudely cobbled together, the vanguard has developed a combat technique that unites attack and defense. Practice caution when fighting this foe.
An elite Landbreaker brute enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is a towering giant armed with a great axe. Such elites are usually seen leading Bonekrusher raiding mobs.
An elite Landbreaker warbeast enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular ripptusk is more ferocious and cunning, and attacks with less predictable moves.
An elite Landbreaker ranged combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is better trained and more accurate, and is armed with better crossbow and bolts.
An elite Landbreaker melee combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB has better gear, strength, and battle skills.
A tuskbeast corrupted by hazefyre. These small aberrations usually move in packs and can pose a serious threat, even to fully armed field teams.
A small warbeast controlled by the Landbreakers. Ripptusks are far more bloodthirsty and ferocious than their untamed wilderness kin. They are absolutely loyal to the Landbreakers who tamed them.
A Landbreaker combatant corrupted by hazefyre. Absorbing hazefyre should not be regarded as a fortunate blessing. These raiders have become horribly twisted versions of their former selves.
A Landbreaker armed with melee weapons. Infiltrators are extremely agile and capable combatants who fight with two weapons at once. They are not to be trifled with.
A Landbreaker armed with a heavy ranged weapon. Ballistas are elites selected from Ambushers who proved their worth. Their heavy bolts are capable of punching right through heavy body armor.

A Landbreaker armed with a flamethrower. Although these weapons look shoddily made, they serve their intended purpose well enough. Arsonists can easily clear out strong points and send the defenders, however stubborn, running for their lives.
A Landbreaker who can wield the Originium Arts of Evocation. Pyromancers are extremely dangerous as they can easily ignite the battlefield with their fiery arts.
A Landbreaker armed with a heavy axe. These massive brutes are way more powerful than their common counterparts and can easily damage defensive works or flip over armored vehicles.
A quillbeast infected by active Originium dust. The creature's spines are imbued with high levels of energy, making them extremely destructive.

An axe armorbeast corrupted by hazefyre. The creature has become extremely aggressive, having been driven into a state of rabid insanity. Approach with caution if you do not intend to be split in half by its "great axe".
A rakerbeast variant featuring a different colored coat, shorter lifespan, but greater strength. Its eye-like spots are far more brilliant and resemble liquid fire.

A wild creature infected by Originium. This acid Originium slug is more hazardous than its ordinary part. The Originium cluster on its back is gaining higher levels of activity and makes the creature increasingly aggressive.
A wild creature infected by Originium. The giant beast carries numerous clusters of Originium that exhibit higher levels of activity. It also sports a thicker carapace than its ordinary counterparts.

A wild arthropod that lives in aquatic environments. The waterlamp gives off a faint glow and its body fluids contain irritants that may induce allergic reactions and even burns. Be careful when tackling this creature.
A wild quillbeast indigenous to Talos-II. When it raises its quills and start rolling around, it becomes as destructive as a spinning chainsaw.
A wild rakerbeast, indigenous to Talos-II. The rakerbeast has a spotted coat that resembles countless eyes, which is useful for bedazzling its prey during hunting.

A wild creature infected by Originium. This slug secretes an acidic material. When threatened, it will attempt to intimidate its foe by shaking violently and projecting shards from the Originium cluster carried on its back.
A wild creature infected by Originium. The large beast carries multiple Originium clusters and is capable of ripping apart its prey with its sickle-like frontal limbs.
A wild axe armorbeast. The creature is clad with bony plates. It can even ram open thick, heavy alloy gates with its axe-shaped horns.

A creature that spews highly corrosive fluids. Nidwyrms usually live underground. They would dissolve metallic materials with acids before consuming them. Nidwyrm hunters are therefore advised to take proper care of their weapons.
An armed outlaw equipped with basic ranged weaponry. Trained in the bamboo groves, the outlaw can fire an arrow through the forest without hitting a single leaf blade.

An armed criminal active in Hongshan territories. Road Plunderers would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Eliminating these brigands is a top priority for Hongshan policing forces.

NO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Though its morphic modules were re-assembled, the entity continues to mimic Nefarith's appearance. No satisfactory explanations have been proposed for this phenomenon.

NO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Changes to its halo may reflect its ability to make tactical decisions. Be warned. Ankhor-like properties have been detected in this entity as well.

The "Genesklydan Dinedon" (archive ID: AGM321δ) is an energized variant of AGM321. Its constituent matter is in a constant, turbulent flow. This also explains its particularly terrifying form when it appears at night.

The "Diaphaistagran Dinedon" (archive ID: ARM315δ) is an energized variant of ARM315. When irradiated by sunlight, it gives off a shimmering purple light. However, it assumes a different form when irradiated by light reflecting off Talos.

The "Tholeroygran " (archive ID: ACM311δ) is an energized variant of ACM311. It utilizes unique energy pathways and thus maintains a homeostatic temperature significantly below the freezing points of its constituent matter.

The "Genesklydan" (archive ID: AGM321) exhibits humanoid head and legs. Ever since the discovery of this particular pattern, human resemblance became an unspoken rule for assessing Aggeloid threat levels.
The "Prismastagran" (archive ID: ASM316) is a non-model variant of ARM315. It is capable of protecting nearby Aggeloi, and is very difficult to hit as it often surrounds itself with ARM315 entities.

The "Diaphaistagran" (archive ID: ARM315) is a fluid-based pattern with energy projecting capabilities. Its shape is that of a complex yet symmetrical geometry. Its attacks can also sap heat from any surface they come in contact with.

The "Tholeroygran" (archive ID: ACM311) is the first fluid-based pattern to be discovered. The morphology of the halo is unstable and the internal temperature is typically lower than its constituent materials.
The "Thureoron" (archive ID: ACL156) is a pattern furnished with a shield-like structure that protects its halo. Be warned. This Aggelos can manipulate energy to drag distant targets towards itself.
A Landbreaker armed with basic ranged weaponry. Ambushers only received the most rudimentary training and their shots are inaccurate. Nevertheless, their bolts have claimed more than a few lives.
The "Psuthopteron Anavon" (archive ID: ARA07Cα) is an energized variant of the ARA07C. Most observers regard color as the only differentiating feature between the Anavon and the basic variants.

The "Psuthopteron" (archive ID: ARA07C) has flight capabilities that are wholly unrelated to its morphology. This pattern was originally regarded as biomimicry. However, the modern consensus believes it was a mimic of Terran flying vehicles.
A Landbreaker armed with basic melee weapons. These "common rabble" of LB clans tend to be poorly equipped and usually appear in groups.
The "Homoiossaron" (archive ID: AGL371) is capable of mimicking human forms or parts thereof. Some of these rare and dangerous entities are capable of channeling the Æther itself.
The "Phrourossaron" (ARS316) is a suspected Aggeloid attempt at mimicking the shape and attack patterns of humanity's sentry guns. Despite its massive range, the Sentinel is a sessile organism.
The "Varykentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL141α) is an energized variant of ARL141 that has retained a plethora of attack patterns. It is a tougher and more dangerous entity.
The "Thrylissoron Anavon" (archive ID: ACL072α) is an energized variant of ACL072. Its high energy contents did not affect its decision-making abilities. This entity is extremely dangerous.
The "Kentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL121α) is an energized variant of ARL121. The entity's higher energy density gives it greater firepower. The energy efficiency of its firing mechanism remains low.

The "Kriosson Anavon" (archive ID: ACL071α) is an energized variant of ACL071. The entity's excessive energy content gives it a characteristic bright red appearance and makes it stronger and faster than the standard variant.
The "Varykentron" (archive ID: ARL141) is a non-standard variant of ARL121. It would occasionally perform whip attacks with its tail instead of using its ranged energy attack.
The "Kentron" (archive ID: ARL121) would charge pieces of itself with energy and propel them with inertial launching. The energy efficiency of this mechanism is extremely low.
The "Thrylissoron" (archive ID: ACL072) is a non-standard variant of ACL071. It can manipulate its environment and make tactical decisions.
The "Kriosson" (archive ID: ACL071) is amongst the earliest recorded form of the Aggeloi and the most commonly encountered. It attacks by ramming its victims with its horns.
